privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Bookly collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Bookly, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, phone number, and booking details. We also collect usage data to improve our services.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.body: We may share limited data with trusted payment processors (Stripe) and analytics providers. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at privacy@bookly.travel to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@bookly.travel.

terms.metaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for using Bookly's tour booking platform.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using Bookly, you agree to these terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before making a booking.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.body: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation. Prices are displayed at the time of booking and may be subject to change until confirmed.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments are processed securely via Stripe. You agree to pay the total amount displayed at checkout, including any applicable taxes and fees.

cancellations.title: Cancellations & Refunds
cancellations.body: Cancellation policies vary by tour. Please review the specific cancellation terms shown on each tour page before booking.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Bookly acts as a marketplace connecting travelers with tour operators. We are not liable for the acts or omissions of tour operators.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact us at support@bookly.travel.
